source: Attention contains matrix multiplications, softmax/reduction behavior, and potentially large intermediate traffic. ZXNAME0000XZ demonstrates that changing the IO schedule without changing dense attention’s mathematical result can materially improve performance.[12]
zh: 注意力包含矩阵乘法、softmax/reduction 行为以及潜在的大中间流量。 ZXNAME0000XZ 证明，在不改变密集注意力数学结果的情况下改变 IO 调度可以显着提高性能。 [12]
